anyone.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
anyone.zh: 我知道不太可能有人愿意帮助我。

admit.en: I admit that this may not be the best way of doing it.
admit.zh: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。

alone.en: It says in the Bible, "Man shall not live on bread alone."
alone.zh: 圣经里有一句话，叫做“人不能只靠面包生活”。

afford.en: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
afford.zh: 法国是一个福利国家，但它却不再能够负担得起了。

accept.en: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.
accept.zh: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。

against.en: Anything you say may be held against you in a court of law.
against.zh: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

alert.en: A tsunami is coming, so please be on the alert.

alive.en: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
alive.zh: 要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。

adventure.en: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
adventure.zh: 他写了一本关于丛林冒险的书。

affection.en: Everyone knows of his affection for that dog.
affection.zh: 人人都知道他对那狗的感情。

address.en: He said that if he knew her address, he would write to her.
address.zh: 他说如果他知道她的地址，他会写信给她。

advice.en: None of this would've been necessary if we'd followed Tom's advice.
advice.zh: 如果我们照了汤姆的话去做这一切都是没必要的。

area.en: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
area.zh: 据说这个区域埋着财宝。

active.en: The volcano has become active again.
active.zh: 这座火山又开始活动了。

angel.en: This morning, I saw an angel.

asleep.en: He was about to fall asleep, when he heard his name called.
asleep.zh: 他快要睡著的时候，听到有人在叫他的名字。

awful.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
awful.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。

army.en: I had been in the army for a month when the war ended.
army.zh: 战争结束的时候，我已经在军队里待了一个月。

avoid.en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.
avoid.zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。

assistant.en: I worked three years as Tom's assistant.
assistant.zh: 我给汤姆当了三年助手。

alcohol.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
alcohol.zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。

alarm.en: It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
alarm.zh: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。

agent.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
agent.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

awfully.en: I was awfully confused by his question.
awfully.zh: 我对他的问题感到非常困惑。

approval.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
approval.zh: 如果您同意, 我想给他这份工作。

anywhere.en: Did you go anywhere during the summer vacation?
anywhere.zh: 这个暑假你有去哪儿玩吗?

admire.en: Visitors to Switzerland admire the Alps.
admire.zh: 游客到瑞士欣赏阿尔卑斯山。

act.en: You are old enough to know better than to act like that.
act.zh: 你够大了知道不要那样做。

absent.en: Nobody noticed that she was absent until the end of the meeting.
absent.zh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。

architect.en: A famous architect built this house.
architect.zh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。

adult.en: Two adult tickets and three children's tickets to London, please.
adult.zh: 请给我两张到伦敦的成人票，三张儿童票。

apologize.en: You should apologize to Dad for not coming home in time for supper.
apologize.zh: 你应该为你没有及时回家吃晚餐向你父亲道歉。

actually.en: You didn't actually want to go to Australia, did you?
actually.zh: 你其实不想去澳大利亚吧？

actress.en: It's said that she's a well-known actress.
actress.zh: 我听说她是个有名的演员。

africa.en: Hemingway enjoyed big game hunting in Africa.
africa.zh: 海明威喜欢在非洲的大狩猎。

ability.en: I'm not satisfied with my English ability.
ability.zh: 我不满意我的英语能力。

attitude.en: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
attitude.zh: 抱著失败主义的态度你无法打一场漂亮的仗。

absolutely.en: I think I understood everything Tom said, but I'm not absolutely sure.
absolutely.zh: 我认为我听懂了汤姆说的所有话，但我不确定。

ashamed.en: I'm very ashamed of myself about what I've done.
ashamed.zh: 我对自己的作为很内疚。

allow.en: The circumstances did not allow me to go abroad.

apology.zh: 汤姆不接受玛丽的道歉。

account.en: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
account.zh: 一些航班由于地震被延误了。

appetite.en: A little walk will give you a good appetite for breakfast.
appetite.zh: 散散步将会给你很好的食欲吃早餐。

attack.en: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
attack.zh: 敌人对那栋建筑物使出了强力攻击。

anxious.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
anxious.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

assist.en: I'll be able to assist you.

available.en: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
available.zh: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。

add.en: Is there anything you want to add to what I just said?
add.zh: 我刚才说的内容，你想补充么？

accident.en: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.
accident.zh: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。

apartment.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
apartment.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。

appreciate.en: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.

artist.en: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
artist.zh: 给这本书画插画的画家很好。

attend.en: "Why are you going to Japan?" "To attend a conference in Tokyo."
attend.zh: “你去日本干嘛？”“去东京参加一个会议。”

attractive.en: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
attractive.zh: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

album.en: He showed me his photograph album.

ancient.en: Rome has a lot of ancient buildings.

audience.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
audience.zh: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。

advance.en: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
advance.zh: 地面高低不平，给部队前进带来了困难。

article.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
article.zh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

amount.en: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
amount.zh: 已经花费了很多的时间和精力。

athlete.zh: 汤姆天生就是个运动员。

apart.en: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.
apart.zh: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。

anyway.en: We're all going to die anyway.
anyway.zh: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。

admission.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.
admission.zh: 五岁以下的小孩票价全免。

artificial.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
artificial.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。

accurate.en: This data isn't accurate at all.
accurate.zh: 这个数据一点也不准确。

art.en: I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
art.zh: 我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

actor.en: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
actor.zh: 你想成为一名电影演员吗？

aggressive.zh: 他是个咄咄逼人的的人。

approve.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
approve.zh: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。

action.en: Action speaks louder than words, but not nearly as often.
action.zh: 行胜于言，但并不是所有情况都是这样。

attention.en: Don't pay any attention to what your father says.

average.en: The average height of girls in this class is over 155 centimeters.
average.zh: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。

astronomy.en: What's the difference between astronomy and astrology?

anger.en: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.
anger.zh: 总理的发言估计激怒了在野党。

author.en: Graham Greene is a favorite author of mine.
author.zh: 格雷厄姆葛林是我最喜欢的作家之一。

affair.en: I have nothing to do with the affair.

acid.en: Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.

attempt.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
attempt.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。

argue.en: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
argue.zh: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。

advise.en: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
advise.zh: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。

arrow.en: The arrow indicates the way to go.

accustomed.en: He quickly accustomed himself to his new surroundings.
accustomed.zh: 他很快就适应了新环境。

absolute.en: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
absolute.zh: 电脑现在是一个绝对必要的东西了。

awkward.en: The girl made an awkward bow.
awkward.zh: 这个女孩做了一把很难使用的弓。

arithmetic.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。

airplane.en: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
airplane.zh: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。

argument.en: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
argument.zh: 经过长久的争论，我终于说服了她去露营。

activity.en: Watching TV is a passive activity.
activity.zh: 看电视是一种被动的活动。

appeal.en: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
appeal.zh: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。

algebra.zh: 代数是我最喜欢的科目。

ambition.en: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
ambition.zh: 以前，玛丽想和一位有雄心壮志的男人结婚。

aware.en: He seems not to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
aware.zh: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。

associate.en: We often associate black with death.
associate.zh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。

appointment.en: Make another appointment at the front desk.

artistic.en: He was raised in an artistic family.

adopt.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
adopt.zh: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。

adequate.en: This meal is adequate for three.

advertise.en: We advertise our products on TV.
advertise.zh: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。

arrest.en: Why don't the police arrest Tom?

angle.en: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.

ache.en: My joints ache when it gets cold.
ache.zh: 当天气变冷的时候，我的关节疼痛。

appear.en: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.

although.en: Although I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.
although.zh: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。

appearance.en: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
appearance.zh: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

ally.en: Germany was once an ally of Italy.
ally.zh: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。

authority.en: He gave me authority to fire them.
authority.zh: 他授权给我解雇了他们。

access.en: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.
access.zh: 我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。

assemble.en: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
assemble.zh: 这个书架组装起来很简单。

agency.en: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
agency.zh: 我们需要人力仲介公司帮我们找到合适的人来担任这个管理职位。

allied.en: Germany was once allied with Italy.
allied.zh: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。

acquaintance.en: I'm very happy to make your acquaintance.

amends.en: It's never too late to make amends.

accompany.en: She will accompany me on the piano.

absence.en: Her absence went unnoticed until the end of the meeting.
absence.zh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。

accuracy.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。

amateur.en: I was still an amateur at that time.

adapt.en: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.

alphabet.en: I remember my mother teaching me the alphabet.
alphabet.zh: 我记得我母亲教我认字。

applicable.en: This law is applicable to all cases.

application.en: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
application.zh: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。

accent.en: Where is the accent on the word 'Australia?'

abolish.en: We should abolish the death penalty.

atomic.en: They know how to make an atomic bomb.
atomic.zh: 他们知道如何制造原子弹。

aboard.en: How many people were aboard that ship?

advocate.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.

adjacent.en: The stadium is adjacent to the school.

apply.en: What Tom said doesn't apply in this situation.

astonishment.en: To my astonishment, my money was gone.
astonishment.zh: 令我惊讶的是，我的钱没了。

ample.en: We have ample time to catch our train.
ample.zh: 我们有充裕的时间赶上火车。

ambassador.en: The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.

astonish.en: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
astonish.zh: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。

annual.en: I don't know my father's annual income.
annual.zh: 我不知到我爸的年收入是多少。

approach.en: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.
approach.zh: 真正的科学家不会这样去思考。

atmosphere.en: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
atmosphere.zh: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

anticipate.en: I anticipate that there will be trouble.

addition.en: In addition to English, he speaks German.

advantage.en: It was an advantage having learned Chinese while I was in school.
advantage.zh: 在学校时我学了中文是个优势。

adjust.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
adjust.zh: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。

antenna.en: The man tried to install his own antenna.
antenna.zh: 这男人试着安装他自己的天线。

announce.en: Tom found a new way to announce his news.
announce.zh: 汤姆发现了一种宣布他新闻的新方法。

achieve.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.
achieve.zh: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。

approximately.zh: 约有三十个年轻人到了。

attach.en: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
attach.zh: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。

assess.en: She can assess investments very accurately.
assess.zh: 她能很准确地评估投资。

automobile.zh: 这家工厂生产汽车配件。

association.en: I applied for membership in the association.

absurd.en: That's the most absurd idea I've ever heard.
absurd.zh: 这是我听过最荒谬的想法。

antarctic.en: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.

agriculture.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
agriculture.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。

arrogant.en: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.
arrogant.zh: 我无法忍受她傲慢的态度。

abstract.en: Some abstract art is difficult to understand.
abstract.zh: 一些抽象艺术是很难理解的。

aspect.en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
aspect.zh: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

achievement.en: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.
achievement.zh: 登月是一项里程碑式的成就。

abbreviation.en: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom.

astronaut.en: She will be the first Japanese woman astronaut.
astronaut.zh: 她将会成为日本第一个女性太空人。

arrival.en: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
arrival.zh: 他们到达的确切时间还不明。

accessible.en: Those records are not accessible to the public.
accessible.zh: 这些记录不对公众开放。

architecture.en: You like to talk about architecture, don't you?
architecture.zh: 你喜欢讨论建筑，不是吗？

attraction.en: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
attraction.zh: 珊瑚礁是这个地区的主要景点。

accommodate.en: The motel can accommodate as many as 400 guests.
accommodate.zh: 汽车旅馆可以接待多达400名客人。

adjective.en: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.
adjective.zh: 在这种情况下，形容词放在名词前面。

affect.en: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
affect.zh: 其他人的期望会影响我们的行为。

antique.en: Can you tell me where the nearest antique shop is?
antique.zh: 你能告诉我最近的古玩店在哪里吗？

assignment.en: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
assignment.zh: 我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。

academic.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
academic.zh: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。

ankle.en: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.

abundant.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
abundant.zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。

allegiance.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.

avenue.en: I'd like to do shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
avenue.zh: 我想在纽约的第五大道购物。

appoint.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
appoint.zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

arrange.en: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
arrange.zh: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。

attribute.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
attribute.zh: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。

abnormal.en: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
abnormal.zh: 环境污染正造成异常的天气情况。

autobiography.en: He devoted the last years of his life to writing his autobiography.

actual.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
actual.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

anniversary.en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
anniversary.zh: 汤姆从没忘记在婚礼周年纪念日送给他妻子花。

atlantic.en: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
atlantic.zh: Charles Lindbergh于1927年成功完成了第一次独自飞越大西洋。

appropriate.en: I had to change clothes because what I was wearing wasn't appropriate for the situation.
appropriate.zh: 我必须要换衣服，因为我现在穿的衣服不适合这个环境。

arctic.en: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
arctic.zh: 南极因为有大陆，所以气温低于北极。
